full_page.content:
1948, Sept. 4
The following is a faithful transcription of the postcard written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Bles'd be God in all His designs ! Sept 4th 1948
God bless you Mr. Winke -- and no less may He bless your dear Wife and children. How wonderful has He not been to you! DEO GR.
I thank you indeed for your favor just noted. Pleas God I shall comply with your request and shall consider it a privilege. I surely congratulate you on not only successes that have come to you of late, but I might say -- now that the sky has cleared -- especially on the unusual knocks whereby you and yours were tried some twenty years ago. How can we ever be fully grateful ?!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original in possession of: Helen Winke 7444 Asbury Park Detroit, MI. 48228
